summary: Procure 200 temporary Albatross Analytics seats with SCIM/SSO and contractor provisioning
requested_items: 200 temporary user seats for Albatross Analytics (6-month term, expires automatically)
SCIM provisioning integration (Okta) with group sync and deprovisioning rules
SAML/SSO configuration and test accounts for contractor pilot (30 active contractors initially)
Access to audit logs for 12 months and API keys for service accounts
Admin roles for IT (Maya Chen), Security (Arjun Rao), and Engineering lead (Diego Alvarez)
vendor_contract_terms: 6-month temporary license, $6/user/month for temporary seats, automatic expiry at term end, optional renewal negotiation 30 days prior. Vendor provided standard SaaS DPA; SLA not included in temp plan.
procurement_notes: Vendor quote Q-ALB-20260309-17 attached in procurement request. Finance requires vendor W-9 and vendor onboarding packet; Legal requested DPA review before signing. Need PO creation and tagging to ENG-Growth cost center.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: temporary contractor seats may remain active if SCIM deprovisioning misconfigured. Mitigation: run SCIM dry-run, enable group-based deprovisioning, and audit logs integration with SIEM.
implementation_steps: 1) Confirm vendor paperwork (W-9, DPA) with Legal and Finance
2) Create PO and send to vendor accounting
3) Enable Okta SCIM integration in staging for 7-day pilot
4) Validate SAML SSO with two pilot contractor accounts
5) Kick off contractor provisioning run and verify deprovisioning flow
6) Flip to prod and confirm audit log delivery and admin roles
